description:
Sleep and resting HR are already logged and only ever read back as their own trend lines. Score today's values against a rolling personal baseline and surface a readiness signal on the Start screen.

Against your own baseline, never population norms: a resting HR of 48 means nothing without knowing what yours usually is. Say nothing at all until there is enough history for a baseline to mean something, rather than showing a confident number computed from three days of data.
title: Deterministic readiness flag from sleep and resting HR
